title.en: BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES THE APEC-NOC AUTHORITY FOR THE PROCUREMENT AND PROVISIONS THE ACQUISITION OF NECESSARY SUPPLIES, EQUIPMENT AND SERVICES FOR mE 1996 ASIA-PACIFIC ECONOMIC COOPERATION MEETING

text.en:
The APEC-NOC Director General is hereby granted authority for
procurement and the activation of a Procurement Committee with appropriate
approving authority level of a Department Secretary.

To fast-track the acquisition of necessary supplies, equipment and
services for the APEC meeting, the APEC-NOC Executive Committee is hereby granted
exemption from the governing rules on public bidding, subject to the relevant
provisions of E.O. No. 301 entitled "Decentralizing Actions on Government Negotiated
Contracts, i..ease Contracts and Records Disposal".

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
I in the year
DONE in the City of Manila, this 8 ~ day of
Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Five.
By the President:
IN REPLVING.
Executive Secretary
